reviews.title: Unfair Matchmaking & Pay-to-Win System
reviews.text: The matchmaking in Diamond League is completely broken and unfair. As a Level 38 player, I’m forced to compete against players who are Level 60+ and start with huge star advantages from day one, leaving me stuck at 10th place right at the start. They have access to items that remain locked for me for another 30 levels, giving them a massive advantage. Why aren't players matched within similar level ranges? Even after buying boosters, it's impossible to compete. My money was completely wasted. I am done paying for this game and uninstalling it.

reviews.title: Not bad - could use some features
reviews.text:
The game is fun but it could use better functionality. 

The events should be filtered by hours left, with the lowest at the top. It’s annoying to scroll down all the way down to find the events ending soon. 

There should also be a better way to remove clothing. I just started playing but I’ve yet to find an easy way to remove a piece of clothing if it’s layered. We should just be able to tap the doll, have the items come up & be able to remove. 

I also would like to see a zoom feature where we can zoom in/out for jewelry. Right now, I have to hit the makeup icon to really see it. 

More options off the bat for new players, especially with diamonds would be great. I’m also not sure how voting works and what the threshold for how many votes are needed before voting closes. It feels like some looks aren’t being scored. 

The designer duds are awesome and the choice of body types is too. I am finding that voters are not loving bigger dolls though. I’d love to see some diversity of faces beyond the Zoolander though. Give us options to smile. 

Overall nice game but could use some features to make gameplay easier.
